title: SEC 1 Prime field compression point prefix selects vertical coordinate parity
summary: On a short Weierstrass curve over a prime field, a compressed point is a 02 or 03 prefix followed by fixed-width x. The prefix encodes even or odd y.
applies: Nonsingular short Weierstrass curves over primes; characteristic > 3
detail: The same x may correspond to two square roots. After restoring and choosing y, the curve equation must still be satisfied.
boundary: The prefix 04 indicates another uncompressed encoding; the Edwards point format does not follow this prefix convention.
relevance: Explain the reason why the two public key codes only have different prefixes but different recovery points.
